description.value: Whistler's craft brewery features a taphouse with a full menu of snacks and pizzas alongside their award-winning beers, including BC's first craft gluten-free lager. They also offer brewery tours and growler fills on-site at their Millar Creek Road location south of Whistler Village.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms active brewery with taphouse serving beer, cider, snacks, and pizzas at 1045 Millar Creek Rd, Whistler. Phone 604 962 8889 found on contact page. Gluten-free beers are prominently featured (Forager Lager, Forager Pale Ale) with multiple awards. No mention of bike parking, water refill, or other cycling-specific amenities on the website or in OSM tags.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active brewery with taphouse serving food and drinks on the Sea to Sky cycling corridor; a natural refuelling stop for touring cyclists in Whistler.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Dedicated gluten-free beer line including Forager Lager and Forager Pale Ale, both award-winning; gluten-free section on taphouse menu

wow_evidence: award-winning beers, including BC's first craft gluten-free lager
